facts.text: The repository is a MuJoCo Gymnasium environment for manipulating flexible objects with a UR5e robot arm and a Robotiq 2F-85 gripper
The repository combines a MuJoCo simulation of the arm, gripper and flexible cable with Gymnasium integration and a graphical environment view
The repository declares the dependencies gymnasium-robotics, mujoco, gymnasium and pynput
The package registers the environment id BaseRobot-v0 with entry point homestri_ur5e_rl.envs.base_robot:BaseRobot
BaseRobot is a subclass of the repository's MujocoEnv
The BaseRobot constructor defaults are model_path ../assets/base_robot/scene.xml and frame_skip=40
The observation space is a Box with low=-inf, high=inf, shape=(28,) and dtype float64
The action space is a Box with low=-1.0, high=1.0, shape=(7,) and dtype float64
The MuJoCo model uses the implicitfast integrator, angles in radians and a timestep of 0.002 s
The initial joint configuration sets shoulder_lift, elbow and wrist_1 to -pi/2 and wrist_2 to pi/2
Each step runs the operational-space controller with action[:6], writes action[6] to the seventh control channel and calls do_simulation(ctrl, n_frames=1) once per frame_skip iteration
step returns the observation with reward 0.0, terminated=False, truncated=False and an empty info dictionary
The observation concatenates the robot qpos and qvel returned by robot_get_obs
reset_model restores init_qpos and init_qvel with set_state and returns the observation
The README states that the repository is not actively maintained and is experimental

determinism.notes: the fake reset draws its start state from Python's random.Random(seed); the upstream MuJoCo environment uses its own random generator, so one seed does not reproduce the same trajectory on the fake and upstream

gaps: the fake backend is kinematic, not MuJoCo: it has no rigid-body dynamics, contacts, friction, actuator or sensor model, and it only integrates the seven action values into a stand-in state
the upstream operational-space controller, the Robotiq 2F-85 gripper and the flexible cable are not modelled by the fake
no wall-clock pacing: realtime_factor 0, ticks advance simulated time by timestep_ms only
the fake was not compared with the upstream environment: gymnasium, gymnasium-robotics and mujoco were not importable where the gate ran
snapshot and restore are not offered: BaseRobot inherits set_state but exposes no get_state
no physical UR5e is modelled and nothing was validated against hardware

measures.description: Last observation (derived from the observation space)
measures.name: observation

safe_state.description: the simulation stops advancing: no step or reset is accepted after an e-stop until mhs.safety.reset clears the latch; the environment state is kept and stays readable
